authors: Rod Burgass, Antonin Chapoy, Valderio de Oliveira Cavalcanti Filho
title: Development of a new method for measurement of the water dew/frost point of gas
experimental_method: Gas equilibrated with water (or hydrate) at fixed T and P is expanded and flowed at ~30 mL/min through a temperature-controlled Sulfinert flow tube; the tube T is cycled and a capacitance moisture sensor detects ice deposition/removal to give the frost point at atmospheric pressure, from which water content (ppmV) is calculated.
uncertainties_stated: T +-0.1 K, P +-0.03 MPa, water content +-1 % of value
quality_remarks: Proof-of-concept method paper. Paper year printed 2021 (volume 530; available online 2020); chunk listed 2020. Water-content basis (mole or volume ppm) and pressure type not stated. Cell/equilibration details are brief. Experimental values agree with CPA predictions within a few percent.
